title: psychotria tahanensis
intro: Psychotria tahanensis, commonly known as Tahan psychotria, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is a type of shrub native to Malaysia, and its leaves have been traditionally used in folk medicine for their various health benefits. The leaves of this plant have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in the treatment of various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Psychotria tahanensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
